notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (PwC). Baht, face and notes. SCI three months p.5, six months p.7. No PAA business. Revenue and expenses from 21.1 (p.64, six months, both years). Unlike the 1Q2025 edition, 15.1.2 (CSM roll-forward, p.53, six months) and 15.1.3 (new business, p.55, with its own 30 มิถุนายน 2568 total column) print balances and movements with the normal sign, so no sign turn is needed. Future-service change = change in estimates + the onerous-contract estimate line, which carries CSM (CSM column). The loss component is a net reversal (152,573,598). The three-month tax line, 'income (expense)', is a credit (9,295,056), kept positive. This edition prints one net line 'รายได้(ค่าใช้จ่าย)อื่น' (six months 1,586,896, three months 1,733,650) where 1Q2025 printed 'other expenses' (146,754) under other expense; the net line is recorded as other income, so the three-month other income and other expense differ from the year-to-date movement by 146,754 Baht each (net profit unaffected). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2568 (p.5).
